title: Crease Game Online
short: A free paper-folding puzzle: fold the sheet along its creases until it covers the dashed outline exactly.
description: Crease Game Online is a free paper-folding puzzle that plays right in your browser. You get a square sheet of paper and a dashed outline, and you drag the paper to fold it until the visible paper covers the outline exactly, with nothing hanging over and nothing left uncovered. Four new puzzles unlock every day, and there are 27 practice puzzles from Easy to Master plus three short lessons for beginners. Undo, Restart and Hint are always one tap away, and solving a puzzle in the fewest folds without hints earns three stars. No download and no account needed.
instructions: Press on the paper and drag to fold it. The spot you grab lands where you let go, and the paper folds along the crease halfway between. Drag sideways or up and down for a straight fold, or at 45 degrees for a diagonal fold. Cover the dashed outline exactly. Red stripes show paper outside the outline. Use Undo, Restart and Hint if you get stuck, and try the three lessons first if you are new.

title: No Map Home
short: A free co-op fantasy RPG drawn in ink: eight classes, 21 wilderness regions and 25 dungeon depths, solo or in a party.
description: No Map Home is a free cooperative fantasy RPG that plays right in your browser. Adventurers followed the Hollow Star underground and never returned, and Mara of Lantern's Rest asks you to rekindle the Nine Watchlights and bring them home. Pick one of eight classes, explore twenty-one wilderness regions, and fight down through twenty-five dungeon depths, alone or in a party of up to eight players in one shared, real-time world. Day and night pass for everyone, your lantern can hide you or draw hunters, and you can hire a mercenary from the guild. Start as a guest with no download and no account.
instructions: WASD or the arrow keys move. Click or T selects an enemy, 1-6 use abilities, V is your class defense, Q and R drink health and energy potions. E or right click interacts. Y kindles your lantern and U covers it. I, C and K open the bag, hero and abilities, M and G the local map and world atlas, and the mouse wheel zooms. On touch screens drag to move, tap to select and pinch to zoom.

title: Brudvig Hockey 2027
short: Free 3v3 arcade hockey in your browser: huge hits, breakaway goalies and a 32-team Challenge Cup.
description: Brudvig Hockey 2027 is a free arcade hockey game that runs right in your browser: three on three, no penalties, huge body checks and a crowd that roars with every hit. Play the computer, run the 32-team Challenge Cup, challenge a friend online for up to eight players, or put the game on a TV with phones as controllers. No download and no account needed to play, just a free profile for the Challenge Cup.
instructions: WASD or the arrow keys skate. Left click or K shoots (tap for a wrist shot, hold and release for a slap shot, or time it with an incoming pass for a one-timer). Right click or E passes or switches skater. Space, F or a double click throws a check (hold for a bigger hit). Q is a spin move with the puck or a poke check without it. Touch controls appear automatically on phones.

title: 4Wall Pong
short: Pong flipped inside out: steer all four walls at once and keep the ball alive as long as you can.
description: 4Wall Pong is a free single-player twist on Pong: the ball can leave on any of the four walls, so you steer four paddles at once to keep it in play. Every hit speeds the ball up by 1%, so a run gets harder the longer it survives. Chase a spot on the global Top 10 leaderboard. Free in your browser, no download and no account needed.
instructions: On desktop, move the mouse or use the arrow keys / WASD to move all four paddles at once. On mobile, drag with your finger. Move a paddle as you hit the ball to change its bounce angle. One miss on any wall ends the run.

title: Knockback
short: A free browser party board game: race your pegs home through erupting arenas and Power-Ups.
description: Knockback is a free party board game you play right in your browser. Race your pegs home while arenas erupt, black holes swallow pieces and Power-Ups flip the board. Pop the dome, move your pegs and knock rivals back to the start. Jump into a quick match with players worldwide, take on the weekly arena and seasonal events, and play on desktop or mobile. Instant play: no install and no account needed.
instructions: Pop the dome to roll, then pick a peg to move. Land on a rival to knock it back to the start, grab Power-Ups to change the board and get all your pegs home first to win. A short how-to video is available when you start.

title: Kart Chaos
short: A free 3D kart racer: Grand Prix cups, Time Trial ghosts, a Daily Challenge and online rooms with friends.
description: Kart Chaos is a free 3D kart racer that runs in the browser on desktop and mobile. Race the Chamo Cup Grand Prix against CPU racers, beat ghosts in Time Trial, take on the Daily Challenge, or open an online room and race your friends. Drift for speed boosts and land ramp tricks. Play with keyboard, gamepad or touch. No download, no sign-up.
instructions: Use the arrow keys or WASD to steer and accelerate. Drift through corners to charge speed boosts and land ramp tricks for extra speed. Gamepad and touch controls are supported.

title: StonkRider
short: Turn real stock and crypto charts into neon motocross tracks and ride the candles.
description: StonkRider is a free bike game that turns real stock and crypto charts into motocross tracks. Pick a ticker like TSLA, GME or BTC-USD and a timeframe, and the candles become hills, ramps and cliffs. Flip off the peaks, chain tricks and grab green-candle orbs for nitro, and try not to crash on the next dip. Every chart rides differently, so there is always a new track. It is just for fun, not financial advice, and needs no account.
instructions: Pick a ticker and a timeframe to build your track. Accelerate and lean to ride the chart, flip off peaks to chain tricks and grab green-candle orbs for nitro. Land on your wheels to keep going.

title: Louvers
short: A calm logic puzzle: slide each slat left or right until every column lights up and a hidden picture appears.
description: Louvers is a relaxing logic puzzle you play right in your browser. The board is made of horizontal slats, each with a few coloured tiles on it. Slide every slat left or right until each column has exactly the tiles it needs and lights up, and the hidden picture appears. There are 33 hand-made levels that start with a short tutorial and get steadily trickier, so it is easy to learn and hard to put down. It works with the mouse, the arrow keys or a touchscreen, with no account and no download.
instructions: Drag a slat left or right, or select it and use the arrow keys, to shift its tiles. A column lights up when it holds the right tiles. Light every column to reveal the picture and finish the level, then pick the next one from the Levels menu.

title: Snowball Fight Online
short: Fast 3D snowball battles in your browser: free-for-all or team battle, power-ups, skins and a daily leaderboard.
description: Snowball Fight Online drops you into a snowy 3D arena where everyone is throwing. Pick free-for-all, where the last snowballer standing wins, or a 10-vs-10 team battle, and jump into a room that is already running. Walk with WASD, aim with the mouse and throw; snowballs run out, so stand still for a moment to pack more. Glowing items on the ground give power-ups you fire with Q or E. There are several maps in rotation, including a Halloween graveyard, 12 characters to unlock, emotes, a chat and a daily and weekly leaderboard. It plays instantly in the browser with no download and no account, and you can save your progress to pick it up in another browser.
instructions: Move with W A S D or the arrow keys. Point the mouse at a target and click to throw a snowball. Stand still for a moment to pack more snow when you run out. Walk over glowing items to pick up power-ups and press Q or E to use them. Keys 1 to 6 are emotes, Enter opens the chat, M mutes.

title: Lemonade Tycoon
short: Run a lemonade stand in a sunny 3D park, tune the recipe to the weather and grow it into a citywide chain.
description: Lemonade Tycoon is a relaxed 3D idle tycoon game. You start with one little cart in a city park, mix your lemonade (ice, lemon and sugar) to match the day's weather, set the price and watch the customers line up. Every day brings a new forecast and sometimes a park event that sends extra crowds your way. Earnings go into upgrades for the stand, promotions and eventually new shops across the city. Daily tasks, a login reward streak and a chest for finishing all tasks give you a reason to come back, and the stand keeps selling while you are away. It runs in the browser with no download and no sign-up, and your progress is saved.
instructions: Click Open now to start the day. Use the Recipe button to adjust ice, lemon and sugar for the weather, Upgrades to improve the stand, Promote to bring in more customers and City to open new shops. Check the Daily tab for today's tasks and rewards.

title: Hisorty
short: Slot historical events onto a timeline, from the Battle of Cannae to the Berlin Wall, and see how far your sense of history takes you.
description: Hisorty is a history game built around one simple move: you are handed a card with a real historical event on it, painted in its own illustration, and you have to drop it into the right spot on a timeline of events already on the table. Guess right and the card locks into place with its year revealed; guess wrong and you lose a life. The daily puzzle gives everyone the same six events to put in order, and Endless mode keeps dealing cards until your three lives run out, so the run is as long as your knowledge holds. It plays with a mouse or a finger, and there is nothing to install.
instructions: Pick Play for today's puzzle or Endless for an unlimited run. Drag the card at the top onto the timeline, to the left or right of the events already placed, depending on whether you think it happened earlier or later. Place it correctly to keep going; three mistakes end an Endless run.

title: guessNow
short: A real photograph from the archives slowly comes into focus and you slide to the year it was taken, before your health runs out.
description: guessNow is a history game built on real photographs. A picture appears out of focus and sharpens as the seconds pass, so every moment you wait costs you points but gives you another clue: a uniform, a car, a shop sign. You drag a slider to the year you think it was taken and confirm. Miss by two years and it barely stings; miss by forty and a chunk of your 300 health is gone. Adaptive Climb keeps dealing photographs and raising the difficulty for as long as you survive, and there is a daily set of five if you only want a quick round. Every photo comes with the full story behind it once you have answered.
instructions: Pick Adaptive Climb for an endless run or Daily Challenge for today's five photographs. Watch the picture sharpen, drag the slider to the year you think it was taken and press Confirm. The closer you are, the less health you lose; three bad misses and the run is over.

title: World Destroyer
short: Flatten a toy city against the clock with TNT, missiles and a very happy dinosaur, chaining the blasts so one sets off the next.
description: World Destroyer drops you on an isometric toy city with a short timer and a handful of tools: TNT, missiles, fire, and later a tornado, a dragon, a robot and a UFO. The trick is not to use them one at a time but to set off chain reactions, hitting a fuel tank so the explosion rolls into the next block and the next. Each city has its own briefing, its own defences to knock out first, and three stars to earn, so a level you scraped through once is worth replaying for the clean run. Ten cities unlock one after another, and new tools arrive as you go.
instructions: Pick a tool from the bar at the bottom, then tap or click where you want it on the city. Hit fuel tanks and AA guns first so the blasts spread for you. Clear enough of the city before the timer runs out to earn stars and open the next one.

title: I See You
short: Multiplayer horror hide-and-seek in the browser: one ghost starts the hunt, and everyone it catches joins it.
description: I See You is a free multiplayer horror hide-and-seek game that runs straight in the browser. One player starts as the ghost; everyone it catches turns and hunts with it, so each round gets more dangerous the longer it runs. As a human you hide under beds, in lockers and behind curtains, hold your breath when something passes, and work on the fuse boxes to restore the power and open an exit before the timer runs out. Three maps are playable - Baiyang Hospital, The Haunted Mansion and The Old Schoolhouse - each with its own layout and story. Jump into a quick match with players from anywhere, or make a private room and send friends the code. No download and no account.
instructions: Move with W A S D, hold Shift to sneak and aim with the mouse. F turns the flashlight on, Space or right-click dashes (the ghost lunges). E hides you under a bed or in a locker and R holds your breath while something passes. Find the fuse boxes to restore the power, then run for an exit before time runs out.

title: Merge Numbers 2048
short: Slide the board, merge matching tiles and push the numbers all the way to 2048 in a few quiet minutes.
description: Merge Numbers 2048 is a free browser version of the number puzzle everyone knows. Swipe or use the arrow keys and the whole board slides; two tiles with the same number touch and become one twice as big. Two becomes four, four becomes eight, and every merge leaves room for the next one. A new tile drops after each move, so the board slowly fills and you have to keep a corner free for your biggest number. Reaching 2048 is the goal, but the real game is beating your own best score, and the board remembers it between sessions. Rounds are short, there is nothing to install and no account to make, and it plays the same with a mouse on a computer or a thumb on a phone.
instructions: Swipe or press the arrow keys to slide every tile in that direction. Tiles with the same number merge into one. Keep your largest tile in a corner and work the other rows around it, and the board lasts much longer. The game ends when no move is left.

title: Block Bloom
short: Drag flower blocks onto a garden board and fill rows or columns to make them bloom.
description: Block Bloom is a calm block puzzle with a garden theme. Three flower pieces wait beside the board; drag each one into an empty spot, and when a whole row or column fills up it blooms and clears, giving you room again. There is no timer, so the challenge is pure planning: every piece has to fit somewhere, and a board full of awkward gaps ends the round. Clearing several lines with one piece scores best, and the garden level climbs as you go. Soft pastel colors and short rounds make it an easy game to pick up for a few minutes, on a computer or a phone.
instructions: Drag a piece from the side onto the board. Fill a complete row or column to clear it. Keep open space for the long pieces and try to clear two lines at once. The game ends when none of the waiting pieces fits.

title: Water Sort: Color Tubes
short: Pour colored liquid between tubes until every tube holds a single color.
description: Water Sort: Color Tubes is a color sorting puzzle. Each tube holds stacked layers of colored liquid, and you can pour the top layer into another tube only if that tube has room and the top colors match, or if it is empty. The goal of every level is one color per tube. The first levels need only a few moves, but extra colors arrive quickly and the empty tubes become precious, so you start thinking several pours ahead. An undo button saves a bad move and you can restart any level. It plays with a mouse or a tap and suits short breaks.
instructions: Tap a tube to pick up its top color, then tap another tube to pour. You can pour onto the same color or into an empty tube. Fill each tube with one color to finish the level. Keep an empty tube free as long as you can and use undo when a pour goes wrong.

title: Snake Trail
short: Steer the snake to glowing orbs and grow longer without hitting the walls or your tail.
description: Snake Trail is a clean take on classic snake. Steer with the arrow keys or a swipe, eat the glowing orbs to grow, and avoid running into your own tail. Every orb makes the snake longer and the board tighter, so a good run is about planning your path, not only quick reactions. Two modes change the game: Walls, where touching the edge ends the run, and Wrap, where the snake passes through one side and comes out the other. The game keeps your best score, rounds last a minute or two, and it works on desktop and on a phone.
instructions: Use the arrow keys or swipe to turn. Eat orbs to grow and score. Do not hit your own tail, and in Walls mode do not touch the edge. Switch to Wrap mode to go through the walls. Leave yourself an open lane when the snake gets long.

title: Jumping Panda
short: Hold to charge, release to jump, and bounce a little panda from platform to platform across a sunny valley.
description: Jumping Panda is a one-button jumping game that runs right in your browser. Press and hold to charge a jump, let go to launch the panda, and land on the next platform without falling short or overshooting. A short press makes a small hop and a long hold makes a big leap, so every platform is a small judgement call about distance. The game is split into numbered levels you can pick from a level menu, and the coins you collect can be spent in the shop. Rounds are quick, the controls are a single mouse button or finger, and there is nothing to install and no account to make.
instructions: Press and hold the mouse button or your finger to charge the jump, then release to launch. Hold longer for a longer jump and land on the next platform. Pick Play to continue from your current level or Levels to choose one, and spend the coins you collect in the Shop.

title: Zombie Survival: Blackout
short: Survive waves of zombies in a rainy night city: move, let your gun auto-fire, level up and beat the boss that arrives after 60 seconds.
description: Zombie Survival: Blackout is a survivor-style action game set in a dark, rainy city. You steer one survivor around an isometric map while the weapon fires on its own, so the whole game is about where you stand: keep moving, stay out of the crowd and collect experience to level up. Each stage has a short countdown to a boss, and coins and XP carry your run forward. Stage 1-1, Residential Blocks, doubles as a tutorial. The game saves an unfinished fight so you can pick it up where you left it, and it plays in the browser with no download.
instructions: Move with W A S D or the arrow keys. Your weapon fires automatically at nearby zombies. Keep moving to avoid being surrounded, pick up experience to level up and survive until the boss arrives. Use the pause button to stop the fight at any time.

title: Chime Blast
short: A musical match-3 adventure: swap pieces, build Bass Drums and Prisms and wake up ten islands across 100 hand-made levels.
description: Chime Blast is a match-3 puzzle game with a musical twist. You travel across ten islands of the Melody Isles with Daming the donkey and his friends, and each of the 100 hand-made levels gives you a goal and a limited number of moves. Matching four or five pieces creates musical tools such as Wave Capsules, Prisms and Bass Drums, and swapping two of them together sets off a bigger blast. Along the way you unlock boosters like the Mallet and Tuning Fork, collect medals and fill in the island map. The game runs in the browser on desktop and mobile with no download and no account.
instructions: Swap two neighbouring pieces to line up three or more of the same kind. Match four or five to create musical tools, then swap them or combine two tools for a bigger blast. Reach the level goal before you run out of moves. Use boosters from the Tools panel when you get stuck.

title: Meowdoku
short: A cat logic puzzle: place one cat in every row, column and color, and never let two cats touch. 300 levels plus a daily puzzle.
description: Meowdoku is a logic puzzle played on a grid of colored regions. Your job is to place exactly one cat in every row, every column and every color, with one extra rule: cats may never touch, not even diagonally. There are 300 levels spread over Easy, Hard and Expert, so the grids grow from 7x7 and the deductions get tougher. A new daily puzzle appears every day, and you can use free hints or the built-in solver when you are stuck. It runs in the browser with no download and no account.
instructions: Tap a square to place a cat. Put one cat in every row, every column and every color region, and keep cats from touching, even diagonally. Pick Easy, Hard or Expert at the top, or try the daily puzzle. Use a hint if you get stuck.

title: Vibestead
short: A cozy pixel-art village builder: run a sawmill and factory, fill customer orders and grow your woodland village.
description: Vibestead is a relaxed village-building and management game with detailed pixel art. You start with a small timber operation: hire loggers, keep the sawmill and construction workshop running, send products to customers and use the profits to unlock new buildings such as a brick kiln, a paint workshop and a village inn. Managers, orders and chapter goals give you steady things to aim for, and your team keeps working while you are away. A coding-rewards feature for developers is optional, and the village game works fully without it.
instructions: Follow the quest panel on the left. Hire loggers, open the Sawmill and Construction workshop from the bottom bar, fill orders, and spend your cash on new buildings. Use the Machines, Orders, Managers and Woodland tabs to grow your village. Your crew keeps producing while you are away.

title: History Gacha
short: Open card packs of real historical events, build a collection and team, and send them into battles and expeditions.
description: History Gacha turns real historical events into collectible cards. Each pack holds five cards drawn from a library of more than 77,000 events with sources from Wikipedia, and rarity is set by a fixed metric, so a famous disaster or discovery can show up as a top-tier card. Collect cards, put a team together, take part in battles, send them on a long expedition, finish quests and earn trophies. A daily check-in gives you extra packs. It runs in the browser, with no download.
instructions: Press Open 1 pack to draw cards, or switch to 5X for several packs. Check your Collection, build a team for Battle, and send cards on an Expedition. Use the daily Check-in and the Quests tab for extra packs.

title: Mars Rally Championship
short: A 3D rally racer on Mars: low-gravity dunes, timed stages with medals, a daily seeded run and live online races for up to eight pilots.
description: Mars Rally Championship is a 3D rally game set on the surface of Mars. You drive a six-wheeled rover across low-gravity dunes, basins and ridgelines, with Martian gravity of 3.71 m/s² shaping every jump and landing. A Rally School teaches the controls before you race. Pick a stage and chase medals, try the daily challenge with a new seeded run every day, take on the weekly featured stage, or join an online room with up to eight pilots. There is also a Mars Cup and a free roam mode. It plays with keyboard, gamepad or touch, with no download and no signup.
instructions: Hold the Up arrow to drive and use the arrow keys to brake and steer. Space is the handbrake, A and Z shift gears, C changes the camera, R restarts and T returns you to the last gate. P pauses. On mobile, use the touch controls.

title: Fuzeborn
short: A pixel card game: rip packs, fuse creatures in the Fuze Pit, build a 15-card army and flip against rivals in a campaign.
description: Fuzeborn is a pixel-art card game about collecting creatures and taking them to war. Rip open packs to fill your binder with 30 creatures across three types, where Ember beats Leaf, Leaf beats Tide and Tide beats Ember. Drop two cards into the Fuze Pit to discover recipes, or fuse two copies to make one stronger. Then choose an army of 15 cards and battle a rival: you both pick a card at the same time and flip, the higher power takes both, and a tie starts a war for the whole pile. Win and you take spoils from the rival's deck. This free demo holds the full Home Front campaign.
instructions: Press Play, open packs and check your Binder. Use the Fuze Pit to combine two cards. Pick 15 cards for your Army, then start a campaign. In battle, choose one of the three cards in your hand; you see the rival's types but not their power.

title: ASHENGRID: Realm of Velkyn
short: A dark-fantasy tactical RPG in the browser: forge a hero, pick a covenant and fight turn-based battles on a grid.
description: ASHENGRID: Realm of Velkyn is a free dark-fantasy RPG that runs straight in the browser. You forge a hero by naming them and choosing one of four classes, the Templar, Sorceress, Necromancer or Valkyrie, then swear to one of the covenants that fight over the six primordial Ember-Eggs, each with its own alignment perk. From there you explore an isometric world with rotating biomes, gather materials with professions and step into short turn-based battles on a tactical grid, where you spend action and movement points to cast spells on target tiles. A motion-comic prologue opens the story, and no download is needed.
instructions: Click Begin Chronicle, name your hero, pick a class and a covenant, then press Forge Hero & Begin Story. Use the mouse to move and interact. In combat, click a spell and then a target tile; spend your AP and MP wisely each turn.

title: Swishes.io
short: 3D pickup basketball in your browser: play 1v1, 3v3 or full-court 5v5, or take on a real opponent online.
description: Swishes.io is a 3D pickup basketball game that runs in your browser with no download. Choose a half-court one-on-one game to 11, run with a crew in 3v3 to 21, or play the full squad in full-court 5v5. You control one player while teammates and rivals move around you, and a deep control set lets you sprint, pump fake, dribble through crossovers, pass, throw alley-oops and set picks. A player builder lets you shape your own baller from presets like Sharpshooter or Playmaker, there is a shootaround to practise your jumper, and an online mode puts you against real players.
instructions: WASD to move, Shift to sprint. Hold Space to shoot (a short press is a pump fake). I, J, K and L do dribble moves, F passes, G throws an alley-oop and V sets a pick. H shows all controls, Esc pauses.

title: Free Nassau
short: A pirate roguelike deck-builder set in 1717: fight ship to ship, then board your prize with a second deck.
description: Free Nassau is a roguelike deck-builder set in the Golden Age of piracy, in 1717. You pick a real historical captain and sail across a chart of battles and ports, choosing your route node by node across three acts that end with Benjamin Hornigold. Each fight starts ship to ship with your Ship deck, firing broadsides and swivel guns, tacking hard and crowding sail while watching the enemy's next move. Once her hull is down to half, you can board and switch to a separate Boarding deck for the close fight. Cards cost energy, the interface is styled after period engravings, and a practice battle teaches the basics.
instructions: Use the mouse, or tap on a phone. On the chart, pick your next destination. In a fight, tap a card to read it, press Play to use it, then press End Turn. Cards cost energy. Fight ship to ship first; when the enemy hull is at half or less, you can board and switch to the Boarding deck.

studioRating.note: Two-deck naval-then-boarding combat gives real tactical choices, and the engraving style looks great; the practice fight explains it well.

title: Snowball Fight
short: Real-time 3v3 winter brawl: push the lane, topple two towers, then the enemy Snow Fort.
description: Snowball Fight is a real-time 3v3 team brawl set in the snow. You and your crew push down the lane, topple two towers and then break the enemy Snow Fort, all inside an eight-minute match. Bots fill any empty slots, so a game can start right away, with no download and no account needed.
instructions: Best on a desktop browser with a window of at least 1200x650 pixels. Follow the on-screen prompts to join a match.

title: Yeet Guys
short: Party obstacle-course races for bouncy beans: run official courses, host a party with friends or try community levels.
description: Yeet Guys is a 3D party game where chunky beans race through big obstacle courses with little legs. Play the official carnival playlist, host a party and invite friends with a code, join public lobbies or try levels made by the community. Customise your bean in the wardrobe and climb the stats. The game is in beta.
instructions: Choose Let's Fall to start an official course, or Host a Party and share the code with friends. Controls are shown in the game.

title: Banana Ops
short: Online monkey shooter with team deathmatch, hardpoint, search and destroy and 1v1 duels on 11 maps.
description: Banana Ops is a free online monkey shooter that runs in your browser. Play team deathmatch, hardpoint, search and destroy or 1v1 duels on 11 maps, earn killstreaks all the way up to the Banana Gunship, and rely on bots that fill every match. No download and no sign-up.
instructions: Controls are shown in the game menu. Pick a mode and a map, then jump into a match.

title: City Stakes
short: A 3D story game set in the city of Ilmara, where companies compete for the skyline and brands for every screen.
description: City Stakes is a narrative 3D game set in Ilmara, a city that is up for sale. Companies compete for the skyline while brands compete for every screen in it. The game loads straight in your browser and runs best on a desktop.
instructions: Use the mouse or touch to follow the story prompts on screen.

title: Lantern Links
short: Turn pipe tiles to carry light from the core to every lantern in an original puzzle with endless levels.
description: Lantern Links is an original pipe puzzle by WebGame.fun. Rotate tiles to carry light from the core to every lantern on the board. The levels are endless and get harder as you go, so it works for a quick break or a longer session.
instructions: Click or tap a tile to rotate it. Connect the light from the core to every lantern.

title: Crypt Crawlers
short: Idle dungeon crawler: pick a hero, fight waves automatically and spend your gold on upgrades.
description: Crypt Crawlers is an idle dungeon crawler in pixel art. Choose a hero such as Bram the Knight, level up through ranks, spin for rewards, collect daily bonuses and push for your best wave record. Your hero attacks automatically, and you cast skills and steer to survive.
instructions: Move with your left thumb or the keys shown in the game. Attacks are automatic. Tap skills to cast them.

title: Vice Arcade
short: Fan-made neon arcade: survive 60 seconds of the Heat Run, swap drivers, grab cash and shake the cruisers.
description: Vice Arcade is a fan-made browser arcade with a neon street-chase mini game. In the Vice City Heat Run you drive a street grid for sixty seconds, switch between two drivers, collect cash cases and escape a rising wanted level. The arcade also has highway and airboat drift games, a map guessing game and puzzle cabinets. It is an unofficial fan project and not affiliated with any game publisher.
instructions: Arrow keys to drive, gas, brake and drift. R restarts, C swaps the driver, M mutes, F goes fullscreen. Touch controls appear on phones.

title: Beat The Chefs
short: Cook one dish against the clock in a single pan, then three judges score your plate against the house chef's.
description: Beat The Chefs is a free browser cooking game built around one stove and a six-minute clock. Pick a signature dish, move ingredients to the board and pan, chop, control the heat, stir and season, then plate before time runs out. Three judges score your plate out of 100 and compare it with the house chef, who cooks the same dish on the same clock. New dishes arrive every day, and you can share your plate as a dare so a friend cooks the same dish against you.
instructions: Move ingredients to the board and pan, hold to chop, set the burner heat, stir and taste, then plate once plating opens in the last minute. Three judges score your dish against the house chef's.

title: OVERDRIVE: Wave Assault
short: Third-person sci-fi shooter: gun down waves of enemies and take on a massive boss in a neon arena.
description: OVERDRIVE: Wave Assault is a 3D third-person shooter played entirely in the browser. You fight through escalating waves of robotic enemies in a glowing sci-fi arena, managing ammo and movement until a colossal boss fight brings the round to a climax. The game features smooth 3D graphics and fast gunplay with no downloads required.
instructions: WASD or arrow keys to move, mouse to aim and shoot. Dodge incoming fire and clear each wave before taking on the boss. Check the in-game HUD for ammo count and health.

title: BoardClash
short: Classic two-player board strategy: deploy your pieces, outmaneuver your opponent and capture their flag.
description: BoardClash is a free browser-based board strategy game inspired by the classic army-on-a-grid genre. Two players deploy pieces of varying rank on a 10×10 board, then take turns moving and attacking in an attempt to capture the opponent's flag. Pieces are hidden from the enemy until combat reveals them, adding a layer of bluffing and memory to every match. Play solo against an AI opponent or challenge a friend in pass-and-play mode. BoardClash is an independent fan project; Stratego is a trademark of Royal Jumbo B.V. and BoardClash is not affiliated with or endorsed by Royal Jumbo B.V.
instructions: Drag pieces to place them during setup. On your turn, click a piece then click a destination to move or attack. The game reveals piece ranks when two pieces clash. Capture the enemy flag to win.

title: Smarter Than You
short: Head-to-head trivia battle: answer faster and more accurately than your opponent to prove you're smarter.
description: Smarter Than You is a head-to-head trivia game where two players race to answer the same questions first. Points are awarded for speed as well as accuracy, so a quick wrong answer can cost you while a confident correct one seals the round. Categories span general knowledge, pop culture and more. Currently in beta, the game is playable in-browser via Game Jolt.
instructions: Select your answer from the multiple-choice options before your opponent does. The faster you answer correctly, the more points you score. First to reach the target score wins.

title: Macbeth: Urban Reign
short: Shakespeare meets street gangs: lead Macbeth's crew through a modern city of power, betrayal and ambition.
description: Macbeth: Urban Reign reimagines Shakespeare's tragedy in a contemporary urban setting. You step into a city carved up by rival crews, playing out the story of ambition, paranoia and downfall through street-level action and dialogue. The core beats of the original play—the scheming, the ascending to power, the unraveling—are transposed onto a gritty modern cityscape. Currently a beta playtest build, available to try in-browser via Game Jolt.
instructions: Follow the in-game prompts to navigate the city and interact with characters. Controls vary by scene; on-screen guidance will appear when input is needed.
